examples.english: And thou shalt depart thence, and shalt go beyond that as far as the oak of Thabor, and thou shalt find there three men going up to God to Baethel, one bearing three kids, and another bearing three vessels of bread, and another bearing a bottle of wine.

examples.english: and thou shalt please God like a new (i. e. young) bull which driveth away the sheep with (his) horns.
examples.source: Instructions of Apa Pachomius in MERC.AR in Budge ed. - part 2

examples.english: And the spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him, and he crushed him as he would have crushed a kid of the goats, and there was nothing in his hands: and he told not his father and his mother what he had done.
